blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Про ___ (индейский петух, acc. sg.).
exercises.why: **петух → петуха** (acc. sg.). Masculine, animate, nominative singular in a consonant. Declines like DLI's студент — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. студента). Ending — (no ending) → -а.  **индейский → индейского** (acc. sg. m., agreeing with петуха). Adjective type III, guttural (after г, к, х) — declines like DLI's русский (every form has the same endings): A. anim. = G., inan. = N. Ending -ий → -ого.  Declension: sg. петух · петуха · петуху · петуха · петухом · петухе; pl. петухи · петухов · петухам · петухов · петухами · петухах.  «The accusative of masculine animate nouns is the same as the genitive. The accusative of masculine inanimate nouns and of all neuter nouns is the same as the nominative.» — DLI, Lesson 32.  «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  Adjectives in the accusative: animate = genitive, inanimate = nominative (masculine and plural); feminine -ую, -юю. — DLI, Lessons 46–47.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Пот — градом сквозь ___ (пожар, acc. sg.) ланит.
exercises.why: **пожар → пожар** (acc. sg.). Masculine, inanimate, nominative singular in a consonant. Declines like DLI's дом — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. дом). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  Declension: sg. пожар · пожара · пожару · пожар · пожаром · пожаре; pl. пожары · пожаров · пожарам · пожары · пожарами · пожарах.  «The accusative of masculine animate nouns is the same as the genitive. The accusative of masculine inanimate nouns and of all neuter nouns is the same as the nominative.» — DLI, Lesson 32.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Отложил дверь, прошел через ___ (сенцы, acc. pl.).
exercises.why: **сенцы → сенцы** (acc. pl.). A plural-only noun (it has no singular); nominative plural сенцы. No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  Declension (plural only): сенцы · сенцев · сенцам · сенцы · сенцами · сенцах.  «The accusative plural of inanimate nouns is the same as the nominative plural. The accusative plural of animate nouns is the same as the genitive plural.» — DLI, Lesson 42.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Ну, рассказала бы что-нибудь про ___ (настоящее, acc. sg.).
exercises.why: **настоящее → настоящее** (acc. sg. n.; an adjective used as a noun). Adjective type IV, sibilant (after ж, ч, ш, щ) — declines like DLI's хороший (every form has the same endings): A. хорошее. No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  Declension: sg. настоящее · настоящего · настоящему · настоящее · настоящим · настоящем; pl. настоящие · настоящих · настоящим · настоящие · настоящими · настоящих.  «Больной, раненый and знакомый are often used as adjectival nouns.» — DLI, Lesson 57.  «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  Adjectives in the accusative: animate = genitive, inanimate = nominative (masculine and plural); feminine -ую, -юю. — DLI, Lessons 46–47.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Солнце встало и светило сквозь ___ (мутная дымка, acc. sg.).
exercises.why: **дымка → дымку** (acc. sg.). Feminine, nominative singular in -а. Declines like DLI's газета — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. газету). Ending -а → -у.  **мутный → мутную** (acc. sg. f., agreeing with дымку). Adjective type I, hard — declines like DLI's новый (every form has the same endings): A. новую. Ending -ая → -ую.  Declension: sg. дымка · дымки · дымке · дымку · дымкой · дымке; pl. дымки · дымок · дымкам · дымки · дымками · дымках.  «The accusative singular of all feminine nouns ending in -ь is the same as nominative. The accusative singular of all other feminine nouns ends in -у or -ю.» — DLI, Lesson 33.  «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  Adjectives in the accusative: animate = genitive, inanimate = nominative (masculine and plural); feminine -ую, -юю. — DLI, Lessons 46–47.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Через ___ (златое ожерелие, acc. sg.)!
exercises.why: **ожерелие → ожерелье** (acc. sg.). Neuter, nominative singular in -ие. Declines like DLI's здание — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. здание). The form changes by more than its ending, so no single ending is given — see the declension below.  **златой → златое** (acc. sg. n., agreeing with ожерелье). Adjective type I, hard — declines like DLI's новый (every form has the same endings, apart from the masculine nominative singular (and the inanimate accusative equal to it), which ends in -ой here, not -ый): A. новое. No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  Declension: sg. ожерелие · ожерелия · ожерелию · ожерелие · ожерелием · ожерелии; pl. ожерелия · ожерелий · ожерелиям · ожерелия · ожерелиями · ожерелиях.  «The accusative of masculine animate nouns is the same as the genitive. The accusative of masculine inanimate nouns and of all neuter nouns is the same as the nominative.» — DLI, Lesson 32.  «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  «Masculine adjectives of the "hard" and "guttural" types have in the nominative the ending -ой if stressed: новый — молодой; русский — плохой, and retain the stress on the ending throughout the declension.» «The adjective «большой» belongs to the guttural type, in spite of its -ш-: большого, большому, большим, о большом.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  Adjectives in the accusative: animate = genitive, inanimate = nominative (masculine and plural); feminine -ую, -юю. — DLI, Lessons 46–47.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: А затем мгновение — прыжок через ___ (век, acc. pl.), с + на −.
exercises.why: **век → века** (acc. pl.). Masculine, inanimate; nominative plural века. Declines like DLI's дом — every plural form has the same endings (A. pl. дома). Ending — (no ending) → -а.  Declension: sg. век · века · веку · век · веком · веке; pl. века · веков · векам · века · веками · веках.  «The accusative plural of inanimate nouns is the same as the nominative plural. The accusative plural of animate nouns is the same as the genitive plural.» — DLI, Lesson 42.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Послушай, Катя, я про ___ (твой лабазник, acc. sg.) тайну одну знаю.
exercises.why: **лабазник → лабазника** (acc. sg.). Masculine, animate, nominative singular in a consonant. Declines like DLI's студент — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. студента). Ending — (no ending) → -а.  **твой → твоего** (acc. sg. m., agreeing with лабазника). A possessive — declines like DLI's мой. Ending -й → -его.  Declension: sg. лабазник · лабазника · лабазнику · лабазника · лабазником · лабазнике; pl. лабазники · лабазников · лабазникам · лабазников · лабазниками · лабазниках.  «The accusative of masculine animate nouns is the same as the genitive. The accusative of masculine inanimate nouns and of all neuter nouns is the same as the nominative.» — DLI, Lesson 32.  «Notice the similarity of the endings of the possessives to the form of «они».» мой · моё — моего — моему — моим — о моём; моя — моей — мою; мои — моих — моим — моими — о моих. — DLI, Lessons 47–48.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Я прошу вас! — слышалось сквозь ___ (её рыдание, acc. pl.).
exercises.why: **рыдание → рыданья** (acc. pl.). Neuter, inanimate; nominative plural рыдания. Declines like DLI's здание — every plural form has the same endings (A. pl. здания). The form changes by more than its ending, so no single ending is given — see the declension below.  **её → ее** (acc. pl., agreeing with рыданья). «её» is a pronoun-type word with its own declension, not the regular adjective pattern, so no ending rule is claimed. Its forms (pl.): её · её · её · её · её · её.  Declension: sg. рыдание · рыдания · рыданию · рыдание · рыданием · рыдании; pl. рыдания · рыданий · рыданиям · рыдания · рыданиями · рыданиях.  «The accusative plural of inanimate nouns is the same as the nominative plural. The accusative plural of animate nouns is the same as the genitive plural.» — DLI, Lesson 42.  «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

The accusative singular of all other feminine nouns ends in -у or -ю.» — DLI, Lesson 33.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.why: **жена → жену** (acc. sg.). Feminine, nominative singular in -а. Declines like DLI's сестра — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. сестру). Ending -а → -у. exercises.why: **тётя → тетю** (acc. sg.). Feminine, nominative singular in -я. Declines like DLI's тётя — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. тётю). Ending -я → -ю. exercises.q: Ты мне, говорит, Жилин, про ___ (поп, acc. pl.) лучше не напоминай.
exercises.why: **поп → попов** (acc. pl.). Masculine, animate; nominative plural попы. Declines like DLI's студент — every plural form has the same endings (A. pl. студентов). Ending — (no ending) → -ов.
